caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden panel intricately carved and colored with various hues. On the left side of the panel, there is a large circular motif filled with golden-yellow and orange stylized foliage, accented by a blue leaf and a central circular blue detail. The background in and around the circular motif is a light brown wood color. Toward the right side of the panel is a male merman figure with light brown skin, a green mustache and hair, and blue eyes. The merman has yellow-gold fins on the sides of his head and a green-scaled fish tail crossing toward the left. Various green and orange foliage details surround and interact with the figure and line the borders of the panel, while the background behind the merman is shaded with purple. The entire motif appears set against a plain, off-white background.
title: Ornamental Woodcarving - Stern Board?
